archive.note: These are the 103 graphs of the LEN project archive analysed in the paper. The archive is distinct from the published LEN-Small description (100 graphs), so no event is marked as belonging to the published subset.

source.authors: A. A. Gopalakrishnan, J. Hossain, T. Elmas and A. E. Sarıyüce
source.dataset: LEN-Small, a subset of LEN: Large Engagement Networks
source.licence_note: Quoted from the LEN paper, which gives no licence version. Exported here: graph structure only (per-graph node indices, directed edges, interaction counts). No message text, timestamps, embeddings or account identifiers.
source.licence_statement: The dataset is released under a CC-BY license, enabling free sharing and adaptation for research or development purpose.
source.paper: Large engagement networks for classifying coordinated campaigns and organic Twitter trends
source.venue: Proc. Int. AAAI Conf. Web and Social Media (ICWSM), vol. 19, no. 1, pp. 688–702, 2025
